scope: Targeted Jazzy overlays for EGO timeout callback diagnostics, configurable map lower boundary, and steady-clock callback/timer diagnostics. This evidence covers source buildability only; it does not establish map quality, planner safety, or flight readiness.

source.patch_order: Canonical patches 0001 through 0013; patch 0014 is a separate QoS experiment based on 0013; patch 0015 is an alternative to 0014 based on post-0013 source and must not be applied after 0014.

patches.validation: Both patches replayed against their recorded post-0009/post-0010 baselines and reproduced the current vendor files byte-for-byte, including CRLF line endings in advanced_param.launch.py.

0012.behavior: Adds steady_clock measurements for synchronized depth/pose callback wall duration and age, occupancy timer start-to-start wall gap, and the latest occupancy fusion wall duration to timeout diagnostics. It does not change mapping or timeout behavior.

0013.behavior: Adds read-only depth and pose receipt counters/stamps via matching diagnostic subscriptions and includes them in timeout diagnostics. It does not change mapping or timeout policy; duplicate image subscription may add diagnostic runtime load.

0014.behavior: Diagnostic experiment increasing EGO and diagnostic PoseStamped subscriber history depth from 25 to 100; it does not change the synchronization policy.

0015.behavior: Replaces the duplicate diagnostic depth/pose subscriptions from patch 0013 with per-message callbacks registered on the existing message_filters subscribers, and counts RMW message-lost events on those same subscriptions. It does not change map or timeout policy.

qualification: Build evidence only. Patch 0013 duplicates subscriptions and may add load; patch 0014 is a QoS experiment; patch 0015 avoids duplicate subscriptions and observes the existing filters. No target, controller, PX4 bridge, or actuator was present.
validation: Patches 0010–0015 have recorded source baselines/builds; patches 0013 and 0015 are alternate receipt diagnostic forms, and 0014 is an optional QoS experiment only. Run 34 lost localization health before EGO inputs; run 35 failed its launch precondition because copied helper files were missing; run 36 had a reset-service response timeout; run 37 produced a valid 60.026 s mapping window and recorded zero RMW message-lost callbacks during the EGO pose-filter receipt gap. All remain diagnostic evidence only; no target, controller, PX4 bridge, or actuator was present. Patch 0016 applies after 0015 only and builds 5/5 packages in #08; #40 shows this diagnostic history change does not eliminate EGO pose-filter receipt gaps. Runtime is recorded in p2-ego-input-interval-diagnostic.json.
